thread:
maria: Hey @eng-security — I need temporary sudo/ssh elevation to open an SSH tunnel to on-prem redis for a one-off data migration (no exports). Window: Tue 2026-03-24 02:00-02:30 UTC. Will run a subset migration through the app, not raw DB dumps. Ticket: INC-4821. Can we get a break-glass for that window?

sam: @maria please confirm exact host, commands, and that you'll be on call to close the tunnel immediately after. Also requires SRE on-call ack.

maria: Host: `redis-prod-1.internal.redwood.local`, port `6379`. Command I plan to run: `./migrate.sh --subset --redact-logs`. I'll be on call and won't export PII.

jess: tagging @alex for scheduling. Paste the SSH snippet here too:```bash
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -NL 6379:redis-prod-1.internal:6379 jumpbox.myorg && ./migrate.sh --subset --redact-logs
```Make sure `--redact-logs` is present and set log retention to 7 days. Also record the exact migration args in the ticket.

alex: I can be on-call for the window. Ops checklist: create ephemeral key scoped to `ssh:redis-prod-1`, restrict to `devops` group, TTL 45m, revoke after migration. I'll coordinate the jumpbox firewall rule for that half hour.

sam: Conditional approval granted for 02:00-02:30 UTC. Conditions: (1) link back to INC-4821 here, (2) use `elevate` to create ephemeral creds, (3) use `--redact-logs`, (4) post pre- and post- verification snippets in this thread, (5) notify SRE 15m before start. I'll attach approval badge when applied. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Provisional break-glass created: id `bg-20260324-01`, scope `ssh:redis-prod-1`, expires `2026-03-24T02:45:00Z`. All actions will be logged to `audit-log-2`.

maria: Ack. Will run `elevate create --ttl 45m --scope ssh:redis-prod-1 --reason "INC-4821 one-off migration"` at T-10m and paste the `elevate show` output here.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder scheduled -> will ping this thread 15 minutes before 02:00 UTC. Verify `--redact-logs` and remove verbose debug.

maria: Pre-run check (02:00 UTC): `elevate show bg-20260324-01` output: `active, principal=maria, ttl=45m, scope=ssh:redis-prod-1`. Starting migration now.

maria: Post-run verification: `curl -sS http://localhost:9000/healthz` => OK. Migration processed ~12k keys; sample checks on `user:*` show no exported PII. Logs include masked values. Closing tunnel and revoking creds now.

sam: Received verification logs and sampled redaction. Revoking ACL bg-20260324-01 now. Revocation time `2026-03-24T02:18:12Z`.

maria: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — closing INC-4821 with notes and commands used.
